notes: Church footprint OSM IDs and lat/lng are based on retrieved feature descriptions, not an inspection of polygon vertices in OSM. Preserve exact attribution.
Building footprint matches are not physical-site publication by themselves; no new Places until independent release gate passes.
Sensible exceptions: one Armagh Anglican cathedral, one Yagma religious land-use site, multiple separate Neviges neighboring churches.
No photograph acquisition or copyright/licensing work is undertaken.

rows.note: Current physical country GB (Northern Ireland), preserve historical candidate country IE; do not merge both St Patrick cathedrals.
